strip.range: {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} from {start}

empty.title: No hotels tracked yet
empty.body: Add your hotel and your competitors in <link>Settings › Hotels</link>. The next scan will fill the dashboard.

snapshot.title: Tonight's market at a glance
snapshot.info: Comp set competitors on the selected channel. Rooms left only adds up competitors whose channel shows an exact count; rates are each hotel's lowest rate.
snapshot.roomsLeftTitle: Sum of {known}/{observed} competitors with exact counts

compression.title: Comp set compression
compression.info: Share of competitors sold out or with ≤3 rooms left tonight (0–100).

adr.title: Comp set ADR
adr.info: Average competitor room rate tonight: the average of each hotel's lowest rate on the selected channel (listed rates, not actual revenue).

revpar.title: Comp set RevPAR
revpar.info: Estimate = comp set ADR × estimated competitor occupancy.

occ.title: Comp set occupancy
occ.info: Estimated from rooms left at {count, plural, one {# competitor} other {# competitors}} with enough data on the reference channel.
occ.roomsLeft: {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} left

trends.title: Market trends
trends.info: ADR is the average competitor lowest rate per night; RevPAR and occupancy are estimates from rooms left.

forecast.title: Demand forecast
forecast.info: Demand score 0–100 for each night: “≈” is the estimated competitor occupancy (from rooms left on the reference channel); a dotted-underlined score is the share of competitors sold out when occupancy cannot be estimated yet. 60 and above is high, 40–59 moderate, below 40 low.
forecast.cellTitle: Demand score {score} ({source, select, occ {estimated competitor occupancy} other {share of competitors sold out (occupancy not yet estimated)}}): {level}

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.info: Competitors sold out or with ≤3 rooms left tonight, nights in the next 7 days with at least half of competitors sold out, pending rate suggestions and failed scans.
alerts.empty: No alerts. Nothing unusual in tonight's market.
alerts.more: and {count, plural, one {# more alert} other {# more alerts}}
alerts.runFailed: The latest {channel} scan collected no data
alerts.ownSoldOut: Your hotel is sold out tonight
alerts.ownLow: Your hotel has only {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} left tonight
alerts.compLow: {name} has only {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} left
alerts.suggestions: {count, plural, one {# rate suggestion} other {# rate suggestions}} awaiting your review

yourHotel.title: Your hotel
yourHotel.empty: Your hotel is not on the watchlist yet. <link>Add it in Settings</link>
yourHotel.info: Occupancy comes from your PMS once you have imported it; otherwise it is an estimate from rooms left (≈). The rate is tonight's lowest rate on the selected channel.
yourHotel.occCaption: occupancy tonight{source, select, pms { · PMS} est { · estimate} other {}}

dataStatus.title: Data status
dataStatus.info: Latest scan across all channels, next scheduled scan, channels with data in the past 24 hours and number of hotels tracked.
